## Analysis

The 160-second annealing run improved the exponent by 0.013637, with sums increasing from 59 to 67 while differences rose only from 55 to 61. However, it finished at the original size \(n=17\), suggesting its add/delete moves did not discover a superior size regime. The remaining 0.071457 gap to the reference indicates that short independent restarts and mostly single-element mutations are insufficient; coordinated moves and sustained exchange between exploratory and exploitative searches are now justified.
